national.findings: Article137 subtracts credited tax amounts from gross assessment and refunds excess; Article137(4) permits separate installment withholding above KRW100,000. Article86(1) noncollection below KRW1,000 concerns positive withholding, not refunds. Original stored complete law also reviewed for Articles137-2 and138.

local.findings: Article103-15 uses 10% of the national decision tax for employer year-end local settlement, then deducts already remitted special-withholding local tax. This specific payroll rule must not be replaced by the independent company-local-base pathway or generalized to all personal annual returns.
